_comment: GENERATED by cortex-gateway/scripts/sync_openai_usage_config.js from cortex-gateway/config/openai_prices.json and the openai.* events of cortex-gateway/config/log_events.json. Do not edit; edit those files and re-run the script.

prices._comment: OpenAI prices per 1M tokens, the ONLY price source for usage recording (FinOps design 2026-11-16 §3, tracker S2-83). Standard tier, read from source_url on effective_date. A model is matched by the longest key its name starts with (gpt-4o-2024-08-06 -> gpt-4o; gpt-4o-mini-... -> gpt-4o-mini). A model with no match is recorded with cost 0 and price_missing=true (event openai.price_missing), never guessed. On a price change: add the new prices with a new effective_date and run `node cortex-gateway/scripts/sync_openai_usage_config.js` (Python mirror). Revisit RV-11.
